plan.notes: Official USM archived 2021-2022 Undergraduate Catalog, Nursing Traditional Program B.S., 'Recommended Course Sequence.' The live catalog (catalog.usm.maine.edu) was WAF-blocked, so this archived edition was used. Catalog states total 120-121 depending on statistics course selected. Choice slots transcribed at minimum credits: PSY 201 (3 cr) instead of MAT 120 (4 cr); CHY 107 instead of CHY 113; HRD 200 instead of SBS 200; NUR 422 instead of NUR 428; plan total 120 (121 with MAT 120). The Year 3 Fall 'Elective (if needed)' 3-cr course is included as required — without it the plan sums to 117, below the 120 minimum. Courses marked * on the catalog page must be completed prior to NUR 300, NUR 301, NUR 306, NUR 307, and NUR 339. Core curriculum requirements in science exploration, ethical inquiry, international, diversity, engaged learning, sociocultural analysis, and writing/reading/inquiry 3 are met through the nursing curriculum per the catalog.
